newsitem.title: UK: Dominion has 1.3 bln stg takeover loan.
newsitem.headline: Dominion has 1.3 bln stg takeover loan.

text.p: LONDON, November 13 (LPC) - U.S. group Dominion Resources has a 1.3 billion stg credit to fund its bid for East Midlands Electricity, according to bankers close to the deal.
Dominion made a 1.3 billion stg all-cash offer for East Midlands on Wednesday.
NationsBank and Union Bank of Switzerland have fully underwritten the credit, which is split into a five-year, 520 million stg revolving credit and a 364-day, 780 million stg revolving credit.
Pricing of the loan is tied to Dominion's commercial paper rating, currently A-2 from Standard & Poor's and B-2 from Moody's, and is expected to initially be 30 bps over LIBOR all- in, bankers said.
The loan will first be syndicated to underwriters in the U.S., followed by a general syndication in both the U.S. and Britain.
NationsBank is acting as syndications agent and Union Bank of Switzerland is administrative agent.
Seven of the original 12 British Recs have been purchased since last March, providing a feast of business for the loan syndications market, which has had a hand in financing almost every bid.
